integrity.claim_scope: Exact period-two root census, branch collision, return-multiplier formulas, finite-parameter asymptotic of the larger branch, and a verified attracting example.
integrity.verification: Analytical two-way reduction and Jacobian calculation; exact symbolic and rational checks are auxiliary.

scientific_limitations: All parameters a,b,c,d are strictly positive, and only primitive real two-cycles are classified.
The strict Schur inequalities characterize linear asymptotic stability; equality cases do not establish nonlinear stability.
The result does not classify higher periods, global basins, chaos, or individual trajectory escape.
Historical priority has not been certified by an independent literature audit.
title: Complete period-two census and fold geometry in a fixed-point-free planar map
